communication_goal: 明确参考图中要借鉴与必须保留的部分。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left and holds a large tablet upright at center, angled slightly toward the floating white OpenAI knot at the right. The tablet has a complete bezel and a blank black screen containing only three simple unlabeled white layout rectangles. Both hands stay at the outer bezel and do not cover the screen. No letters, icons, captions or extra devices.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，恰好一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。平板电脑边框、屏幕和按键完整可见且没有可读内容；reference、match、preserve 保持语境词。
